en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a river with forested banks and visible logs floating in the water. One person can be seen standing near the shore. The top left corner of the image reads 'Skallböleforsen, Medelpad.' The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a green stamp from Sweden (Sverige), and is addressed to Fru Hilda Nilsson, Sånggatan 59, Sundsvall.
